title: Acquisitive Podcast Ep 06
description:
Episode 06: Donna Lewis

We know time kills deals, but do you know how much longer it takes to work with a non-preferred lender vs a SBA Preferred Lender? 

Don't accidentally add months to your loan processing, work with a qualified Preferred SBA lender like United Community Bank, and a loan originator who's no stranger to doing deals and a little coaching along the way.
